text: Retrieval-augmented generation reduces but does not eliminate hallucination: leading legal research tools including Lexis+AI and Westlaw AI-Assisted Research still generate false citations or facts in 17 to 33 percent of cases.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Morgan A. Gray, The Evolving Role of Artificial Intelligence in Law (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5541658

isBasedOn.name: The Evolving Role of Artificial Intelligence in Law

abstract: the risk of "hallucinations," where AI generates false legal citations or facts, as observed in tools like Lexis+AI and Westlaw AI-Assisted Research, which hallucinate in 17–33% of cases.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: as measured at the time of the cited study; the authors note rates are progressively improving
